reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The external source sculpture shows Gambit lunging horizontally over a large upturned blue robotic HAND, wielding a staff with pink projected energy and a flowing long trenchcoat. Eight published Gambit covers were reviewed. The closest thematic grayscale candidate mdl_bfc3295a0b7670d2b2ab depicts Gambit running upright along a robot HEAD with tubes, different robot geometry, foot placement, arm gestures and coat composition; other seven covers use standing, couple, separate diorama, bust, or different base/pose. Same character does not mean same 3D sculpture.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Manual source-to-candidate shape and base comparison with hashed images and multiple viewing angles. dHash differences corroborate but do not automatically establish distinctness.

mediaReview.notes: ZEZ Studio marks and Patreon promotion visible on external images. Identity approval never authorizes gallery import, cropping, watermark removal or use of publisher content.

decision.nextGate: Review rights, licensing, attribution and exact production identity before assigning deterministic model ID or publishing any source imagery.
